description: Drops the 'proxy walk' jargon. Bid thread now classifies each step from the observer's perspective: Nom (opening bid), Forced Increase (same franchise as previous high — MFL walked their hidden proxy), Overtake (different franchise dethroned the leader). Classification computed client-side by walking each per-lot thread chronologically.

Fixed Origin classification — was returning Other for backfilled players; now resolves Rookie Draft / FA Auction / WW / MYM-Rookie via draftResults + transactions probe.

ERA nomination cadence switched from rolling 12h cooldown to ANCHORED 12h windows (6 AM / 6 PM ET). Opens Sat 6 PM ET, closes end of Tue 6 AM–6 PM ET window. Banner + per-franchise card show current window label + used_in_window.
